* Phase 12.2: the calculator and service consume SourceTick with per-vendor latest-by-ts_vendor state
  :PROPERTIES:
  :ID:          ips12-calculator-sourcetick
  :CHECKS:      cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo test -p index-calculator -p index-price-service && cargo check --workspace --all-targets && cargo xtask check dep-rules
  :BOUNDARIES:  crates/modules/index/calculator/src/lib.rs crates/services/index/index-price-service/src/cache.rs crates/services/index/index-price-service/src/health.rs
  :RESERVED:    the ordering rule (settled D2: latest per (instrument, vendor) by ts_vendor, no identity, no de-duplication of equal ts_vendor); the plan-12 offer rule (offer at a 1s boundary only when the source's latest ts_vendor advanced); the 5s staleness / 1s future-skew bounds
  :END:
  Goal: Reference — `12_ref_source_tick_contract.md` §3 D1, D2 and §4. Make `index-calculator` and the thin `index-price-service` consume `SourceTick`, and replace the calculator's identity-based slot logic with the settled ordering model (decision D2). This is the model the Index Calculator uses (`docs/atlas/risk/ATLAS - Index Calculator.md` §4; `docs/atlas/risk/ATLAS - Market Data Subscriber.md` §2.1), so plan 13's blend only adds gates and aggregation. The model: calculator state is kept per `(instrument, vendor)` and holds the tick with the greatest `ts_vendor`. A strictly older tick is ignored. An equal `ts_vendor` is the same vendor event, so either copy may be stored, and it is not an error. There is no identity, no content fingerprint and no receive-time slot ownership. At each epoch-aligned 1 s boundary (the existing `run.rs` timer), an instrument is offered iff its configured source's latest `ts_vendor` is greater than the `ts_vendor` of the last tick offered for that instrument. Otherwise nothing is sent for it: a quiet feed still sends nothing in plan 12, and plan 13 adds the every-second offer. The existing bounds stay: reject a tick whose `ts_vendor` is more than 5 s before its `ts_recv` or more than 1 s after it (`MAX_STALENESS_NANOS`, `MAX_FUTURE_SKEW_NANOS`). The existing content checks stay: wrong source, wrong ccy, non-positive price, and a price that truncates to zero or is unrepresentable at target scale. `MarketTarget` becomes `{ feed_id, target_price_decimals, vendor: Vendor, field, quote_currency, demo: bool }`, with `demo` taken from the listing row's current `demo_session` flag, and loses `source_id: String`, `native_product` and `native_field` (native-product binding stays in the subscriber). Remove `IdentityMode`, the identity-mode and provenance guards, `check_dedup`, `check_provenance` and `slot_index(ts_recv_ns)` ownership from `slot.rs`. Keep the bounded drain, `PendingOffers` expiry, the serialized submission worker and `submit.rs` unchanged apart from the input type. In `index-price-service`, the subscriber still emits `PriceObservation` in this phase. The service's `cache::forward_and_cache` converts each one with `SourceTick::from_observation(&obs, demo_row)` from phase 12.1, where `demo_row` comes from the loaded listing row. A conversion error is dropped and counted in the health report as `invalid_ticks_dropped`. Everything downstream (the cache, the debug routes, the health inputs and the calculator channel) carries `SourceTick`. Priorities: the settled D2 ordering exactly; keep every existing behaviour test whose intent survives D2; a compiling workspace after this phase.
  Acceptance:
  - `grep -R "PriceObservation" crates/modules/index/calculator/src` is empty, and `index-price-service` references `PriceObservation` only in the `forward_and_cache` bridge call
  - `newest_ts_vendor_wins_per_vendor_and_older_is_ignored` asserts that a greater ts_vendor replaces the stored tick and a strictly older one does not, regardless of arrival order
  - `equal_ts_vendor_copies_are_not_errors` asserts that two ticks with equal ts_vendor from one vendor produce no rejection and at most one offer
  - `boundary_offers_only_when_ts_vendor_advanced` asserts that a boundary with no advance sends nothing, and that a tick whose latest ts_vendor arrived in an earlier second but advanced past the last offered one is offered at the next boundary
  - `demo_row_orders_by_edge_receipt_time` asserts that a Hyperliquid demo row whose bridged ts_vendor equals ts_recv is offered and ordered by that time
  - `slot.rs` tests whose intent survives D2 are kept and pass against `SourceTick`: greatest_eligible_vendor_time_wins_receive_breaks_ties, vendor_time_regression_alone_is_rejected, new_native_event_with_unchanged_price_is_eligible_and_distinct_from_replay, empty_slot_emits_nothing_then_an_ordinary_observation_still_works, wrong_source_is_rejected_before_touching_slot_state, price_that_truncates_to_zero_at_target_scale_is_rejected, non_positive_price_is_rejected, staleness_and_future_skew_boundaries, content_return_a_b_a_is_eligible_after_an_intervening_accept (renamed if the old name no longer describes them)
  - the identity, provenance and receive-slot tests are deleted, and the phase decisions list each deleted name with a one-line reason: repeated_identity_after_close_with_older_vendor_time_creates_no_new_offer, conflicting_content_under_a_repeated_identity_is_distinguished_from_a_duplicate, conflicting_content_against_the_open_slots_current_winner_is_also_distinguished, no_vendor_time_orders_by_receive_time_and_still_dedupes_native_repeats, missing_identity_is_rejected_never_unwrapped, sequence_regression_with_equal_vendor_time_must_fail, identity_mode_change_under_unchanged_feed_event_provenance_must_be_rejected, provenance_mode_change_must_not_replace_feed_event_ordering, boundary_tick_belongs_to_the_new_interval_and_previous_closes_once, late_observation_for_a_closed_slot_is_rejected_not_relabelled, elapsed_empty_slot_must_not_reopen, long_quiet_interval_after_a_populated_slot_must_not_reopen, slot_index_boundary_is_half_open
  - `MarketTarget` has exactly the fields feed_id, target_price_decimals, vendor, field, quote_currency and demo
  - `bridge_error_is_dropped_and_counted` asserts that an observation the bridge rejects never reaches the calculator channel and increments `invalid_ticks_dropped` in the health report
  - the observation cache, the debug routes and the health report read `SourceTick`, and the existing cache and health tests pass against the new type
  - all existing tests still pass
